## Summary
The control plane lands as a new `hh-control` crate — the closed
strategy contract vocabulary, the `react/minimal` variant + the staged
variant registry, the sealed `EnvelopePolicy` with six guard points,
the stop protocol with drain, retry/timeout/reservation machinery,
INV-1…9, the deterministic loop detector with the `nudge→deny→stop`
ladder, strict output validation, and the driver that sequences
`next_cue → decide → check → control.decision → execute → stop
protocol → terminate → lifecycle.run.finished` over scripted ports.

- **`hh-ontology::control`** — the canonical `StopReason` closed sum +
  `StopKind` tags + `CancelledBy` + the `OutcomeClass` projection (CC10);
  I5's reservation is **reason-scoped** — `stop{completed}` is a
  legitimate model-owned proposal; the infrastructure reasons
  (`budget_exhausted`, `invariant_violation`, `timeout`,
  `format_failure`, `retry_exhausted`, `loop_detected`, …) are
  envelope-reserved and refuse `Owner::Model` at `open`
  (AC-R-2.6.1-6; ADR-0256 D1).
- **`hh-compiler::plan`** — the 3-member `StopReason` subset on
  `stop-rule` nodes retires to `StopKind` (CC1; the tag spelling widens
  additively — all 9 tags parse).
- **`hh-baseline`** — **deleted** (the Stage-0 throwaway; doc 3 §11.0
  "deleted at the Stage-0 boundary" — landing `hh-control` is that
  boundary; its duplicate `StopReason` subset retires with it).
- **`hh-control::vocab`** — the closed sums: `Cue` (13 members incl.
  `woken{peer_message}`), `ControlDecision` + `DecisionKind` +
  `DecisionStamp` + `DecisionPoint` (re-uses `hh_ontology`), `Owner`,
  `GuardPoint` (six), `Decider`, `ScopeKind`, `ControlError`, the
  wait/ladder/failure sums.
- **`hh-control::policy`** — `EnvelopePolicy` (sealed,
  content-addressed `policy_id`, tamper → `verify_seal` fails) +
  `RetryPolicy` × scope_kind × error-class + `TimeoutPolicy` (kind-fixed
  terminals, `hard_max`, ancestor caps, `extend_on_progress`) +
  `LoopPolicy` + `OutputValidationPolicy` + `ExhaustionPolicy` +
  `InvariantSet` (a missing member fails validation).
- **`hh-control::{strategy,react,state}`** — the `ControlStrategy`
  contract; `ControlState` mandatory header `{variant_ref, cursor,
  decision_count, open_effects, last_cue_seq, boundary_view}`;
  canonical `checkpoint`/`restore` (`VariantMismatch`/`DialectMismatch`);
  `react/minimal` with the F1 decision table; the staged-variant
  registry — `react/steerable`, `hh/plan-execute@1`, `hh/workflow@1`,
  `hh/program@1` register + bind (Goal + Procedure) but park
  `decide → wait{human_input}` inside envelope ceilings until their
  spec'd stage (never fake a step; ADR-0256 D6).
- **`hh-control::{envelope,guards}`** — `Envelope::arm` (pure fold —
  restore ≡ rebuild, INV-9) + `guard` at the six points + the driver's
  `check(d') → admitted | refused` view; guard verdicts are
  strategy-independent (β is data — AC-R-2.6.2-9 structural);
  `GuardContext` carries folded `remaining`, derived `deadlines`,
  `open_scope_ids`, gauges, `cancel_requested`.
- **`hh-control::stop`** — the stop protocol: barrier (INV-3) → drain
  (children cancelled, in-flight to terminal/`unknown`, `drain_timeout
  ⇒ unknown` + reason swap) → `lifecycle.{turn,run}.finished{status,
  stop_reason, outcome_class, unresolved_effects[]}`; the barrier admits
  the grace call only.
- **`hh-control::retry`** — `schedule_retry → retry{attempt_no,
  not_before} | give_up{error_class}`; **shared `model_call_id` across
  retries** with monotone `attempt_no` (INV-5); single `retries`
  counter (INV-6); retry-after honoured; bounded deterministic jitter;
  non-retryable classes (`context_length`, `invalid_request`,
  `content_policy`, `cancelled`) never retry; `irreversible` never
  auto-redispatched (INV-8); derived `deadline(scope) =
  min(hard_max, ancestors)`; reservation sizing per ADR-0107 D6.
- **`hh-control::loops`** — deterministic `loop_detector`
  `{exact_repeat, no_progress, error_streak, monologue}` over
  `loop_key = H(semantic_id ∥ canonical(params))` (never the surface
  name); `no_progress` = same key ∧ same `Observation.version_id`;
  closed ladder `[nudge, deny, stop]` — streak evidence resets on
  detection so each rung needs fresh evidence (ADR-0256 D5);
  `control.loop.detected{detector, pattern, evidence_refs[],
  ladder_position}`.
- **`hh-control::output`** — the strict pipeline `parse → surface ∈
  compiled ModelSurface → schema → SurfaceArgMap → param-domain →
  truncation/refusal/empty`; the closed 8-member failure sum;
  `control.output.rejected` carries `detail_ref` (content address —
  rejected bytes never ride the row); `stop{format_failure}` at
  `max_format_failures`; `repair_then_strict` declared (C1 member).
- **`hh-control::invariants`** — INV-1…9 pure predicates over the
  durable prefix; a violation appends
  `control.invariant.violated{invariant_id, evidence_refs[],
  detected_at_guard}` **before** the envelope's stop decision →
  `stop{invariant_violation}` → `infrastructure_failure` → quarantine
  checkpoint; the run is not scored.
- **`hh-control::views`** — `EnvelopeView` materialized fold (counters,
  open scopes, retry state, validation state); rebuild equality tested.
- **`hh-control::driver`** — the turn loop over scripted ports
  (`ModelPort`, `EffectGate`, `AssemblerPort`, `LedgerSink`): the cue
  inbox, checkpoint-per-decision (`checkpoint_ref` on every
  `control.decision`), the F2 seam (a refused proposal still posts its
  decision row; an envelope stop posts `decider: envelope` + enters the
  protocol — never re-dispatches post-barrier), `context.assembled`
  appends per model call (DF-S1.19-1 partial discharge), and
  **resume-by-leaf** = `restore` + `observe` tail + `Envelope::arm` +
  **G-RESUME** (a pre-crash drain restates as `stop{reason}` —
  AC-R-2.6.2-8's resume half).
- **`hh-ledger::classes`** — `DECISION_FIELDS` extended additively with
  the §5e.1 members (`decision_id`, `decision_point`, `owner`,
  `checkpoint_ref`, `cursor`, `verdict`, `submission_ref`; `reason`
  widened to the bounded `StopReason` record); new rows
  `control.loop.detected`, `control.output.rejected`,
  `control.invariant.violated` (kernel), `control.plan.emitted` (audit —
  declared), `control.compute.decided` (citable — declared).
